newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady in active trade.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates were steady in lively trade on Friday as banks needed funds for pensions, dealers said.
"We had a more active day. Banks withdrew substantial funds for pensions, but supply was also quite good," one dealer said.

Fresh loans totalling 27 million kuna ($4.6 million) were slightly overshot by supply. Of this, 19.5 million were call money deals at a stable 10.5 percent. The only exception was one savings bank, which borrowed funds at a slightly higher 11 percent.
Another single 7.0 million three-day loan was made at 11 percent.

Thursday's overnight trade totalled 2.8 million kuna, sought by one bank with shortfalls. Another bank needed funds for its mandatory reserve payments. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 5.857 Croatian Kuna)
